CHECK BURST CS-asm-fg — assemble the cliffside FOREGROUND canvas from 17 outpainted chunks with minimum-error seams and depth-fade alpha (Matt R-C3-48). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-asm-fg".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v3/chunks_v3.json (paint_order: each chunk's index [cx,cy], origin_px, files; canvas 5376×4096; chunk 1536×1024; step 1280×768); painted chunks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-v3-<cx>_<cy>/chunk_<cx>_<cy>.png (flat #00ff00 = void) — EXCEPTION: where a re-drive directory CS-v3-<cx>_<cy>-r1/chunk_<cx>_<cy>.png exists (1_4 and 2_4), use it instead of the original; per-chunk masks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v3/chunk_<cx>_<cy>_mask.png; the full-canvas DEPTH map /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v3/ortho_canvas_v3_depth_mm.png (uint16 mm below rim; 65535 = not foreground) and mask /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v3/ortho_canvas_v3_mask.png. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract, edge_mode='clamp'). python glue with PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files; work in RAM carefully (the canvas is 5376×4096 RGBA).

STEP 1 — per chunk: RGBA = clamp-matte of the painted chunk; alpha restricted to that chunk's mask dilated by 6 px.
STEP 2 — composite in paint_order onto a transparent 5376×4096 canvas. For each chunk, inside every overlap with pixels already placed, cut along a MINIMUM-ERROR path (cost = mean |RGB| between existing and new where both are opaque; where only one is opaque it wins; DP ±1 px per step; vertical path for left overlaps, horizontal for top overlaps; a corner square goes to the lower-cost side), feather ±3 px. Record per seam: chunk pair, path mean cost, p95.
STEP 3 — DEPTH FADE (a matte, not a paint change): multiply the canvas alpha by f(depth): 1 for depth ≤ 8000 mm, (20000 − depth)/12000 between 8000 and 20000, 0 for ≥ 20000 and for 65535.
STEP 4 — write out/foreground.png (5376×4096 RGBA, straight alpha); out/foreground_preview_1344x1024.png (over #3a3f4a); out/seams.json (every seam) and out/checks.json (per-chunk IoU vs mask, spill, seam stats summary: count, mean of path means, worst path mean with its pair); out/seam_worst_crops.png (512×512 crops centred on the 4 worst seams, 2×2). out/summary.txt ≤ 12 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-asm-fg"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
